labels.source_quote: # Prevalence of recurrent and non-recurrent BRCA1 and BRCA2 pathogenic variants in Polish breast cancer patients: insights from a regional genetic testing cohort from Lower Silesia

Genetic tests in breast cancer (BC) patients are increasingly prevalent in oncology, both because of the high incidence of breast cancer (general population risk is 12%) and the potential for effective preventative care in carriers of causative pathogenic (PVs) and likely pathogenic variants (LPVs) [ 1 ].
